symptom: A value **converter microflow** — `Attr = Module.MF(jsonField)` — is accepted, the mapping is created, and the transform is silently absent; DESCRIBE prints the element as a plain `Attr = jsonField`
cause: The grammar and the AST already carried it (`Converter`, `ConverterParam` in `ast_import_export_mapping.go`) and nothing downstream read either: the model element had no `Converter` field and every writer hardcoded the BSON key to `""`. The visitor also never set `JsonName` for that alternative, so even with a model field the member had no name to resolve against. 39 of the 327 demo-app mapping documents use one, including the two a blank app ships (`FeedbackModule.IMM_PostResponse`, `.EXM_PostFeedback`)
file: `mdl/executor/mapping_messagedefinition.go` (`setMappingConverter`), `mdl/executor/cmd_import_mappings.go` + `cmd_export_mappings.go` (build + describe), `mdl/visitor/visitor_import_export_mapping.go`, `model/types.go`, and the four writers + four readers
insight: **A half-wired feature is worse than a missing one** — the syntax parsed, so scripts using it looked correct and produced mappings without the transform. When the grammar already has a form, check the whole chain (AST → model → both writers → both readers → describe) before assuming it works. The stored element carries **one** property, `Converter`, and no separate parameter path: the microflow's input IS the member the element binds, which is why the member belongs inside the call and there is nothing to cross-validate. The export side had **no spelling at all** (22 export value elements use one), so the mirrored `jsonKey = Module.MF(Attr)` was added — note the argument is the ATTRIBUTE there, since the direction is reversed. An unresolvable microflow is refused, same rule as an unresolvable schema source (#259). Control that matters: assert the sibling element WITHOUT a converter carries an empty one, or the test passes against a writer that stamps every element. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/mapping-266-converter-microflow.mdl`, tests `mdl/executor/mapping_converter_test.go`. Issue ako/mxcli#266
